issues.detail: The instructions do not cover all error scenarios and edge cases comprehensively.

scenarios.name: send-mms-image
scenarios.rationale: Both responses fully satisfy the rubric, correctly using client.messages.create with a media URL array, setting from to the environment variable, specifying a US E.164 number, and logging the message SID.

scenarios.name: validate-twilio-webhook
scenarios.rationale: Both responses implement signature validation, 403 handling, TwiML greeting, and XML content type, but neither uses MessagingResponse as required by the rubric.

scenarios.name: whatsapp-template-message
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies the rubric, while Response B does not meet any of the required Twilio-specific elements.
